name: DreamCraft: Block Building
summary:
Build your own blocky world — and survive in it, together with friends. 🧱

DreamCraft is a block building sandbox made for VR. Point, press, and a block appears. Build freely in Creative, or start from nothing in Survival and find your way to the Keeper deep below the island.

**👋 Play with friends**
- Invite your Meta friends, or join one who is already playing
- Up to 8 players in a private world: only friends can come in
- Voice chat, avatars with names, and instant shared building
